image_prompt.text: A small marble temple standing at the island's high point, the structure the whole zone reads toward
A worn track threading the grass from the island's edge up to the temple
The island itself: a floating chunk of earth with flat grass on top and jagged bare rock underneath, hanging in open sky
Banks of white cloud surrounding the island on every side
Freestanding decorative marble columns set around the temple
Cherry blossom trees in bloom scattered across the grass
A large glowing crystal formation erupting from the island

notes: would have asked: Sounds like one explorable sky island — the marble temple as the landmark you head for, a worn path across the grass to it, and the whole thing built as a single continuous map. That's the Exploration layout, minus the hidden secret alcoves it normally carries. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

Preset caveat: took Exploration but dropped its alcove-secret option. The prompt is an enumerated showpiece (temple, columns, cherry blossoms, crystal) with no hint of hidden discoveries, and secret cutouts behind overgrowth would be padding. Shape and the other two options kept, so the preset is still recognisable.

Close genre call: adventure.md's boundary note says a landmark that is the whole point, with nothing to collect and no gate it opens, is an Entertainment Showcase. Kept Adventure because the user self-declared "a Roblox adventure game" and called this an endgame zone within it, i.e. a destination in a journey rather than a standalone hangout.

would have asked: Do players walk on this island, or is it a decorative model the camera orbits? Assumed walkable — grass on top plus "endgame zone" — so no SET. If it is display-only, append SET to the route; nothing else changes.
would have asked: Do players go inside the marble temple? Treated it as a solid monument, which keeps the build on P0. An enterable interior would add P3, which is not ready yet.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
Not layout features, passed through for whoever builds the model: expose attributes cloudSize, crystalGlow and islandSize.
Art direction from the prompt: blocky/stylized, built from primitives, magical endgame mood.
